title: PBA: Converge eclipses TNT in OT for 5th straight win
summary: Converge will carry a five-game winning streak into the playoffs of the 2026 PBA Governors' Cup after outlasting TNT in overtime, 114-112, Sunday at the Ynares Center in Antipolo.
